title: Rotor Warranty and Discard Thickness Terms, Brake Service Warranties
content:
**Discard rule, every line.** A rotor measured below the vehicle maker's (OEM) minimum thickness must be replaced instead of resurfaced. This discard rule is the same on all six lines of Brake Service Warranties.

**Rotor warranty.** Rotors installed on a brake job carry a warranty against warping or cracking for the line's rotor warranty months, counted in calendar months; the third column states whether resurfacing for vibration within that rotor warranty is free.

| Brake service line | Rotor warranty against warping or cracking, calendar months | Resurfacing for vibration within the rotor warranty free | When a rotor must be replaced instead of resurfaced |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Value Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty | 0 | No | below the OEM minimum thickness |
| Crestline Standard Brake Service 24-Month/24,000-Mile Warranty | 12 | Yes | below the OEM minimum thickness |
| Crestline Ceramic Brake Service 36-Month/36,000-Mile Warranty | 12 | Yes | below the OEM minimum thickness |
| Crestline Premium Ceramic Lifetime Pad Warranty | 12 | Yes | below the OEM minimum thickness |
| Crestline Complete Brake Service Lifetime Pad Warranty | 24 | Yes | below the OEM minimum thickness |
| Crestline Severe-Duty Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty | 6 | No | below the OEM minimum thickness |

**Points of the table.**
- The Crestline Value Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty carries a rotor warranty of 0 months.
- The Crestline Complete Brake Service Lifetime Pad Warranty carries the longest rotor warranty, 24 months.
- The Crestline Severe-Duty Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty carries a 6-month rotor warranty, and resurfacing for vibration within it is not marked free.
- On the Standard, Ceramic and Premium Ceramic lines the rotor warranty is 12 months with resurfacing for vibration free within it.
